![](images/6a/6ac300eec61cc9b6f45e6ba5b3b5455bd8255f465c1d592ad5ee4269f317f3ce.png)

Consider the circle of radius $8$ centered at the origin, as shown above. Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for $θ ∈ [0, 2π)$, traverse the circle once in the counterclockwise direction starting at the point $A(8, 0)$?
corrected_content.worked_solution: The standard counterclockwise circle of radius $8$ about the origin is $x=8\cos t$, $y=8\sin t$. At $t=0$ it starts at $(8,0)$, and its initial velocity points upward as required.
